data.name: Kinayah
data.gender_notes: Kinayah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the root word 'Kin' which means awareness. This name signifies being conscious of one's surroundings and the events unfolding around you. The name Kinayah carries the meaning “Awareness” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Kinayah usually hope their child will grow to embody awareness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: This name is believed to bring about a deep sense of awareness and intuition, helping the bearer navigate through life with clarity and purpose.
data.etymology: Kinayah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Awareness.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kinayah total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: كناية
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يدل على معنى غير صريح
in_arabic.long_meaning: الكناية هي اسم يدل على معنى غير صريح، يستخدم في اللغة العربية للإشارة إلى شيء بطريقة غير مباشرة، و هو من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني عميقة في اللغة العربية و في القرآن الكريم.

in_urdu.name: کنایہ
in_urdu.meaning: ایک نام جو غیر واضح معنی کی طرف اشارہ کرتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: کنایہ ایک ایسا نام ہے جو کسی چیز کو غیر مستقیم طریقے سے ظاہر کرتا ہے، یہ نام عربی زبان میں گہری معانیを持つ ہے اور اسلامی تقریر میں اہمیت رکھتا ہے.

in_hindi.name: किनाया
in_hindi.meaning: एक नाम जो अस्पष्ट अर्थ की ओर संकेत करता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: किनाया एक ऐसा नाम है जो किसी चीज़ को अप्रत्यक्ष तरीके से प्रकट करता है, यह नाम अरबी भाषा में गहरे अर्थ रखता है और इस्लामी परंपरा में महत्व रखता है.

in_pashto.name: کنایه

data.cultural_impact: The name Kinayah holds a rich cultural significance in the Arab world, particularly in Islamic communities. The Arabic language is known for its beautiful and evocative names, and Kinayah is no exception. In Islamic societies, it was once a popular name for both males and females, reflecting a value placed on awareness, mindfulness, and keen observation. The name Kinayah underscores the importance of being attentive to the world around us, and the deep influence this can have on our personal lives, relationships, and society at large.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Kinayah can be understood as a reminder of the need to be aware of, and connected to, the divine presence in our lives. It is in being consciously present and attuned to the world around us that we can more fully experience the wonders and mysteries of life, and ultimately, deepen our spiritual understanding and growth. Through the practice of mindfulness and heightened awareness, we can cultivate a closer relationship with the divine, and come to appreciate the inherent beauty and meaning of all things. In the words of the Prophet Muhammad, "Verily, Allah is beautiful and loves beauty." (Bukhari) Thus, the name Kinayah inspires us to embody this beautiful quality, not only in our actions and interactions, but at the deepest levels of our being.
